title: Sales Professional Certificate
overview: This course equips participants with essential knowledge of sales as both a function and a process. It delves into self-management, the art of prospecting, opportunity planning, and resource allocation. Participants will also develop critical skills in negotiation, overcoming sales obstacles, resolving customer issues, and closing deals. The course aims to enhance overall sales effectiveness through practical, real-world applications.
audience: This training is designed for sales professionals, sales support staff, and individuals aspiring to sales roles who seek to enhance or refresh their selling skills.
methodology: The 'Sales Professional Certification' course is highly interactive, utilizing business cases based on real-world scenarios. Participants will actively engage in analyzing situations and devising solutions.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify the behaviors and skills essential for maximizing sales performance
Develop personal habits to enhance selling efficiency
Apply each stage of the sales process and understand the purpose behind them
Master the principles of negotiation and objection handling
Understand customer relationship management and influencing sales outcomes
